data.name: SAVE THE KINGDOM SIMPLE RPG
data.detailed_description:
A classic 2D RPG adventure awaits where a young man has lived in the shadow of the parents in his entire life he never knew, sheltered in the forest home they built before their passing. But a quiet life was not his destiny. Now, at eighteen, he's ready to forge his own path—one that follows directly in theirs. His goal is simple but daunting: join the Adventurer's Guild, uncover the truth of his family's past, and become the hero the kingdom needs.

This is a compact, story-driven game designed to be a memorable adventure you can experience from start to finish. Dive into a simple, classic RPG route where the narrative is at the heart of every quest.

Features:

  • A Gripping, Short Story: Immerse yourself in a focused narrative adventure. If you're determined, you can unravel the entire tale in a single day. (Only 3 hours loag game play story. If you play accordingly it will not take much time to finish.)

  • Uncover a Hidden Legacy: Your journey to become an adventurer is also a quest for answers. Find clues and stories about the parents you lost and learn about the sacrifices they made.

  • Battle Classic Monsters: Test your skills against a variety of familiar foes. From the lowly slime to cunning orcs, terrifying bats, and even mighty dragons and demons, every enemy is a new challenge.

  • High-Stakes Combat: Every battle matters. In this adventure, defeat is final. If you lose a single fight, your journey will come to an end.

  • Save Your Progress! Heed this warning, adventurer: save often! Before you embark on a new quest, enter a dangerous cave, or log off for the day, make sure to save your game. Your progress depends on it.

This isn't just a quest for glory; it's a journey of self-discovery, of honoring the past while fighting for the future. The kingdom's fate rests on your shoulders. Pick up your sword, step into a world of adventure, and forge your legend.

Now enjoy the game and share it with your friends!

data.short_description: Embark on a heartfelt journey with a young orphan determined to follow in his heroic parent's footsteps. From a secluded life in the woods to the front lines of a kingdom in peril, uncover a hidden legacy and face down classic monsters. Will you rise to become the hero you were always meant to be?

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS *: Windows 7/8.1/10 (32-bit or 64-bit)
  • Processor: Intel Core 2 Duo or better
  • Memory: 2 GB RAM
  • Graphics: DirectX 9 / OpenGL 4.1 capable GPU
  • Storage: 400 MB available space
  • Sound Card: DirectX compatible sound card
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: Windows 10/11 (64-bit)
  • Processor: Intel Core i3 2.00 GHz or better
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Dedicated graphics card with 512MB VRAM
  • Storage: 1 GB available space
  • Sound Card: DirectX compatible sound card
  • Additional Notes: Game performance may vary depending on your system's hardware and software configuration. For the best experience, please ensure your graphics card drivers are up to date.
